Class Operator

java.lang.Object
br.edu.unipampa.varzinho.domain.people.Operator
public final class Operator extends Object
The staff account that operates VarZinho. Its plain password is never retained.

  • Constructor Details

    • Operator

      public Operator(String name, String username, String password)
      Registers a new account. The password is hashed with a fresh random salt and then dropped; only the hash is kept.
      Parameters:
      name - the person's name, as shown in the window
      username - what the operator signs in with; stored in lowercase, so sign-in ignores case
      password - at least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name or username is missing or blank, the username contains whitespace, or the password breaks any of those rules

  • Method Details

    • restore

      public static Operator restore(String name, String username, String passwordHash)
      Rebuilds an account exactly as a repository stored it. The hash is checked for format only; the password rules applied when the account was registered.
      Parameters:
      name - the person's name
      username - the stored username, lowercased as on registration
      passwordHash - the stored hash, as getPasswordHash() returned it
      Returns:
      the account
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name or username is invalid, or the hash is not in the format this class writes

    • checksPassword

      public boolean checksPassword(String password)
      Tells whether a typed password is this account's. The comparison takes the same time whichever byte differs, so the answer's timing gives nothing away.
      Parameters:
      password - the password as typed; null is simply wrong
      Returns:
      whether it matches the stored hash
